lines: A Hegemony rifleman saw a movement across the wire.
One shot. The Concord sniper never got up.
Sixty-seven men hit by morning. Forty Hegemony, twenty-seven Concord.
Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. From its observation tree, the Hegemony spotters watched every head in the Concord trenches.
Twenty-five of them fell. Twenty-one Hegemony. Their families sent the next in line.
Both hospitals are full. Every bed is taken.
Seventeen Hegemony wounded wait on stretchers, in the mud.
Now the fight is for Blackwater Canal.
Concord twenty-one. Hegemony four. The first side to kill one hundred enemy soldiers takes Blackwater Canal.
New at the front: a letter from home.
Open your soldier's card and send one. It keeps your soldier fifteen percent safer for one night. Three letters are already on the way.
Yesterday, 53 new soldiers came up the line. 29 Hegemony, 24 Concord.
And today, each side votes for what it needs most.
Hospital, pillboxes, or ammo. Comment one word.
Comment Concord... or Hegemony. Link in bio.
